notes: A never-reviewed card is state Learning, step 0, stability/difficulty null, due = creation time.
elapsedDays = whole days (floor) since lastReview; 0 for the first review.
scheduledDays = whole days from reviewedAt to the new due, only in Review state; 0 otherwise.
Review intervals use Python round() = round half to even (MidpointRounding.ToEven in C#).

cases.name: good_only
cases.description: New card answered Good at every due time.

cases.name: again_first
cases.description: New card: Again, then Good at every due time.

cases.name: again_twice_in_learning
cases.description: Again, Good, Again inside the learning steps, then Good.

cases.name: lapse_and_relearn
cases.description: Graduates, lapses with Again in Review, relearns with Good.

cases.name: repeated_lapses
cases.description: Several lapses in a row from Review and Relearning.

cases.name: overdue_reviews
cases.description: Reviews done much later than due (retrievability well below 0.9).

cases.name: same_day_in_review
cases.description: Review-state card reviewed again 3 h and 5 h after graduating (short-term stability).

cases.name: early_reviews
cases.description: Reviews done before the card is due.

cases.name: easy_first
cases.description: New card answered Easy (skips the learning steps), then Easy and Good at every due time.

cases.name: hard_in_learning
cases.description: Hard inside the learning steps, then Good.

cases.name: hard_and_easy_in_review
cases.description: Graduated card answered Hard and Easy in Review, including late and early reviews.

cases.name: hard_and_easy_in_relearning
cases.description: A lapse, then Hard and Easy while relearning.
